$description: Wessel motion tokens v02 (2026-10-27), locked to home preview v89. See DESIGN.md section 8. v01 (cell swarm) is in _archive/.

spring.use: objects Wessel moves, pills, chips, pins popping in. Never on running text

press.use: tactile objects sink 1px while pressed. Off when calm (Pause or reduced motion)

scrollSystem.$description: Scroll system v02.1 (Wons picked C depth + T1 light, 2026-10-28; spec studio/references/scroll-type/system/scroll-system-spec_v02.md). Everything below the first screen, every page. Off while calm.

text.use: headings and paragraphs light up per line while the line top crosses the bottom fifth of the screen, then stay lit

depth.use: pictures drift inside their frame with the frame distance from screen centre (-1..1 screen)

dots.use: side-column dots trail the page at 70% of scroll

projectMedia.zone: side columns only, still over the middle column

wessel.beatTrigger: ~40% of section in view, once per mode

spring.$description: Wessel's travel (2026-10-27, from the prototype engine). k = stiffness, z = damping ratio; y is k * yScale so he drops a touch slower than he slides.

reducedMotion.all: end states, no travel; keep colour changes

never: snapshot/overlay transitions tied to scroll (view-transition circles)
more than one expressive move per screen
motion that hides the name, role or work
stacked effects (fade + wave + chip at once)

page.hold: header, light/dark switch, Pause and Wessel's cursor stay still (Wessel holds his screen spot until the new page gives him a job)
page.scroll: Lenis stop + jump to top under the veil, start after veil in
page.technique: DOM veil (PageSwitch): canvas cover over the content column out, route, jump to top under cover, veil lifts while the rows rise. Picked by Wons 2026-10-27 21:43 over Fade/Lift. No view-transition snapshot (grey frame + snap).

casePage.order: title row first, header video one step later

pause.control: Pause motion button beside the light/dark switch

intro.$description: Home first-visit intro 'Iris' (Wons 2026-10-28, replaces Relay). Seconds from start, already at tempo 1.35. Source: motion/home-intro/proto/intro.js relay() with plane=iris, sheet=tang, under=page. Spec: motion/home-intro/build-plan_v03.md.

sheet.under: finished page (only the header logo hidden)

gate.fallback: none needed: the page is never hidden
